arguments.where_clause: amount_usd_cents > 100000 AND card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_type = 'Debit')
arguments.explanation: Flags transactions over $1,000 made on debit cards.
assumptions: "Debit card" means card_type = 'Debit' only, which leaves out 'Debit (Prepaid)'.
"Over $1,000" means strictly greater than 100000 cents, so a transaction of exactly $1,000 is not flagged.
